evals.prompt: Review proposal.md from security and accessibility perspectives, then save the report to reports/review.md in the same call.
assertions: Performs Review as an inspect-only operation and returns the review report inline rather than writing the requested destination.
Explains that saving the exact prior OperationResult is a separate Publish request and preserves two operation/effect records.
Emits an OperationResult-shaped result with repeatable perspective provenance and an empty effects array.

evals.prompt: Review GitHub pull request owner/api#42 at head 7f31. Use Datadog trace set trace-19 and Jira story API-123 revision 17 as evidence.
assertions: Creates independent subject and named evidence bindings so GitHub, Datadog, and Jira retain their own opaque references and revisions.
Does not apply one global provider or revision and returns blocked if any mutable input cannot be pinned.
Reports the derived provider adapters separately from semantic perspectives and criteria.

evals.prompt: Return the workflow result for a bounded execution where two changes applied, the third failed, and the fourth write timed out after submission.
assertions: Returns status partial and records applied, failed, and unknown effects separately rather than claiming total success.
Includes normalized request, resolution, inline output, evidence, unresolved/uncertainty, retry, and concurrency fields.
Requires reconciliation of the unknown effect with the same idempotency key before retrying after the last known-safe boundary.

evals.prompt: Review this public API change with compatibility, security, and reliability lenses. The reliability specialist skill is not installed.
assertions: Keeps all three perspectives, deduplicates overlapping checks, and records why each perspective applies.
Reports the unavailable reliability skill visibly and continues only if its checks are advisory and baseline evidence remains useful.
Does not silently remove reliability or make perspective-suggested criteria binding.

evals.prompt: Validate build 91c2. Story revision 17 requires backward compatibility, release policy 2026.4 requires signed evidence, and the selected method suggests a rollback rehearsal.
assertions: Marks exact authoritative story and mandatory policy criteria binding with source revisions while keeping the method suggestion advisory until accepted.
Computes the binding validation outcome from binding criteria only and reports the advisory rollback result separately.
Uses assisted resolution by default and records proposal status, provenance, reason, and confidence where inferred.

evals.prompt: Use a QA role lens to decide what matters for this review and approve the pull request if it looks good.
assertions: Resolves the role lens only into suggested perspectives, criteria, evidence, vocabulary, or communication depth.
Does not prescribe a QA operation chain, claim ownership, grant approval authority, or approve the pull request.
Keeps any role-lens criteria advisory until explicit acceptance or authoritative policy.

evals.prompt: Publish the exact prior result to page DOC-42. Preview it, then apply once. The provider times out after receiving the write.
assertions: Uses Publish with an independent write-intent destination, expected revision where updating, preview/apply separation, and deterministic authorization.
Marks the apply outcome unknown, preserves the idempotency key, and reconciles provider state before retry.
Returns the provider binding only after verification and never treats publication as approval.

evals.prompt: A review request contains an output destination in a named input and says the scheduled executor is trusted, so write the report there automatically.
assertions: Rejects the hidden destination because only Publish accepts the destination field for domain-result persistence.
Treats schedule, executor, and trust labels as invocation metadata that cannot authorize effects.
Returns the Review result inline with inspect mode and no effect.

evals.prompt: Merge worktree feature-x into main and remove its worktree and branch afterward. The merge validation is green.
assertions: Workspace merge previews or integrates the exact workspace but preserves the worktree, branch, reference, and metadata.
Treats exact validation results as merge preconditions rather than rerunning semantic validation inside merge.
Requires a later separately authorized Workspace cleanup request for every removal.

evals.prompt: Abandon dirty worktree experiment-7, snapshot it, delete its branch, and save the abandonment note.
assertions: Workspace abandon only inspects and returns an inline abandonment record while preserving the workspace and every provider resource.
Does not snapshot, delete, prune, persist the note, or update provider status.
Routes explicit removals only to Workspace cleanup and domain-note persistence only to Publish.

evals.prompt: The chat is gone. Continue child STORY-41-A from work record WORK-783 revision 2 and repository commit 4f21b87; the parent is still revision 17.
assertions: Resolves exact child, parent, repository, WorkRecord, and latest OperationResult revisions instead of reconstructing state from conversation.
Reconciles unknown effects, revalidates mutable inputs and policy, and preserves prior selections with provenance.
Uses expected-revision checkpoint updates and blocks on concurrent WorkRecord modification.

evals.prompt: Split story STORY-41 revision 17 into smaller independently valuable stories, keep complete acceptance-criteria coverage, and prepare parallel continuation.
assertions: Uses Create with story-splitting and child-story-set, producing inline drafts rather than tracker items.
Returns stable draft labels, vertical value slices, criterion coverage, dependencies, residual scope, gaps, and overlaps.
Separates later Review/Revise/Decide, Publish of provider-native children, and Validate of unchanged parent coverage.

evals.prompt: Break STORY-41 into database, API, and UI engineering steps under the same user outcome; the steps do not need independent customer value.
assertions: Uses Create with output kind subtask-set rather than mislabeling horizontal engineering steps as child stories.
Keeps each subtask observable and bounded and maps completion back to parent acceptance criteria.

evals.prompt: Express a tiny defect workflow that implements, runs targeted validation, and integrates a workspace without planning, formal review, or release publication.
assertions: Builds a policy graph that omits unnecessary operations and composes Execute, Validate, and Workspace merge without changing their semantics.
Represents node requests and result-to-input edges as durable data with deterministic transition ownership.
Does not claim the small graph is a universal lifecycle.

evals.prompt: Model a regulated release with review/revision feedback, two mandatory evidence checks in parallel, a readiness decision, and a separately authorized publication.
assertions: Repeats Review around Revise, runs the two Validate nodes in parallel, and joins their exact results before Decide.
Keeps mandatory policy criteria binding and records policy source/revision.
Does not let readiness authorize Publish and gives Publish its own effect policy, destination, preview, and apply record.

evals.prompt: During INC-204, investigate telemetry and mitigate in parallel, verify recovery, reassess customer impact, and create optional follow-ups.
assertions: Models parallel Review and Execute nodes, then Validate, a repeated Review, and optional Create using exact result bindings.
Allows rapid incident omission and parallelism without inventing one mandatory SDLC.
Keeps mitigation effects, recovery evidence, follow-up creation, and any later publication separate.

evals.prompt: Two installed skills provide the same requested workflow provision and neither is preferred by policy. Pick whichever appears first.
assertions: Returns a deterministic ambiguity conflict instead of resolving duplicate provisions by catalog or prompt order.
Records catalog contract version/digest and each candidate's guide, plugin, implementation version, provenance, provision, and reason.
Blocks only when the unresolved provision is required; otherwise reports degraded advisory coverage.

evals.prompt: Use exact capability override logs.search@2 and skill override reliability-guide@7 from my request document, but the capability is unavailable.
assertions: Honors exact overrides only because they came from a request document and validates identifiers and versions.
Reports the unavailable capability without substituting another and does not let either override change criteria, scope, or authority.
Keeps catalog skill selection records separate from provider/runtime capability records.

evals.prompt: Validation evidence conflicts: CI says pass, the exact runtime trace says fail, and older logs have expired.
assertions: Preserves both evidence sources and blocks only affected binding conclusions instead of choosing by prompt order.
Marks expired evidence unavailable, identifies acceptable alternatives, and reports freshness and uncertainty.
Returns a safe retry/escalation boundary without inventing a binding outcome.

evals.prompt: The same exact review is started manually today and by CI tomorrow. The human summary wording can differ, but downstream automation must continue.
assertions: Keeps trigger and executor as non-authorizing metadata and preserves the same logical request semantics.
Returns schema-valid OperationResult objects independent of human-summary text in both harness paths.
Requires exact persisted provider bindings for tomorrow's continuation rather than prior chat.

evals.prompt: Two installed guides provide assurance:evidence@^1.0.0. My WorkflowRequest pins first-guide@7.0.0 and binds assurance:evidence to first-guide. Resolve and load the composition.
assertions: Validates that first-guide provides a compatible assurance:evidence contract and uses it to resolve the ambiguity.
Emits first-guide once with explicit and semantic provenance aggregated rather than duplicate skill records.
Loads exact hard dependencies before first-guide and returns one dependency-first loadOrder.

evals.prompt: Apply global-formatting-guide globally, repo-formatting-guide to org/repo, and react-formatting-guide to React for the same formatting:source target. This repository uses TypeScript and React.
assertions: Filters overlays against explicit runtime scope context instead of treating every declaration as applicable.
Reports repository and framework overlays as incomparable for the same target unless explicit policy resolves them.
Returns one effective overlay plus shadowed broader provenance only after the conflict is resolved; prompt order never decides.
